meta.name: data-visualization
meta.description: Data visualization with chart selection, color theory, and annotation best practices. Covers chart types (bar, line, scatter, heatmap), axes rules, and storytelling with data. Use for: charts, graphs, dashboards, reports, presentations, infographics, data stories. Triggers: data visualization, chart, graph, data chart, bar chart, line chart, scatter plot, data viz, visualization, dashboard chart, infographic data, data presentation, chart design, plot, heatmap, pie chart alternative

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据数据自动推荐图表类型并优化配色与标注
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把数据变成清晰美观的图表
copy.tagline_en: Automatically recommend chart types and optimize colors and annotations based on your data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn data into clear and beautiful charts

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的数据自动选择图表类型（如柱状图、折线图、散点图），并遵循配色、标注等设计规则生成可视化图表。
howto.when: 当你提到“数据可视化”、“图表”、“柱状图”、“折线图”等关键词，或要求制作报告、仪表盘、信息图时触发。

say.text: 帮我用柱状图展示各季度营收，突出最高值。
say.note: Claude 会生成排序后的水平柱状图，并高亮最大值。

say.text: 画一张折线图，对比今年和去年的月收入趋势。
say.note: Claude 会生成带标注和填充区域的折线图。

say.text: 用热力图展示一周内各时段的网站流量。
say.note: Claude 会生成带数值标签的热力图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically select chart types (bar, line, scatter, etc.) based on your data and generate visualizations following design rules for color, annotation, and axes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "data visualization", "chart", "bar chart", "line chart", or ask for reports, dashboards, infographics.

say_en.text: Show quarterly revenue as a bar chart, highlighting the highest value.
say_en.note: Claude generates a sorted horizontal bar chart with the max highlighted.

say_en.text: Create a line chart comparing this year and last year's monthly revenue.
say_en.note: Claude generates a line chart with annotations and fill.

say_en.text: Make a heatmap of website traffic by day and hour.
say_en.note: Claude generates a heatmap with numeric labels.
